notes: Final amendment reporting results. commencement_date is the date the Schedule TO (with the Offer to Purchase) was originally filed, October 12, 2021; the filing gives no Offer to Purchase date and does not say 'commenced' in words. size_shares 302,216 comes from the filing-fee note (5% of shares outstanding) and equals the shares accepted. Proration factor is stated as 'Subject to final delivery of all tendered shares'. Purchase price $6.9810 = 97.5% of NAV at the November 8, 2021 close. Note the cover page leaves the 'issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4' box unchecked, but the document is an issuer tender offer statement. Conditions are only referenced, not listed, so conditions is null. No reason for the tender is stated, so trigger_origin is null.
